scripts.dev: pnpm run generate:puzzle-ids && wrangler dev --env dev
scripts.validate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run generate:puzzle-ids && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run generate:puzzle-ids && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.migrations:apply:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev
scripts.migrations:apply:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
